name: scry
description: 本地桌面 app：通过原生 Provider adapter 驱动 AI coding agent，把执行过程实时画成 trace 树（可观测/可控制/可恢复）
author: bingjiang0611

scripts.build:cli: tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && rm -rf packages/turn-recorder-cli/dist && tsc -p tsconfig.recorder.json
scripts.check:cli-release: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/cli/update.test.ts src/core/turn-recorder src/shared/turn-record.test.ts src/shared/trace.test.ts src/shared/runtime.test.ts src/main/normalize.test.ts src/main/danger.test.ts src/main/claude-locate.test.ts src/main/managed-turn-commit.test.ts && npm run build:cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.pack: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:cli && electron-builder --dir && npm run check:packaged-app && npm run smoke:electron
